title: Quest Foglight for Databases FileServlet External Control of File Path Information Disclosure… (CVE-2026-92193)
description: CVE-2026-92193 is a medium severity vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases affecting the FileServlet component. It allows authenticated remote attackers to disclose sensitive file path information due to improper validation of user-supplied paths. This flaw can lead to information disclosure with SYSTEM-level context.
